messages:
Priya (AE): Heads-up: Prospect requires a fully air-gapped POC. No outbound allowed. They asked for an installable USB bundle, SBOM, signed manifests, and clear upgrade cadence. Need estimates on packaging time and one-off fees.

Diego (SE): We can do USB bundles. Questions: k8s vs VM? Container runtime? GPU drivers (NVIDIA driver + CUDA)? Also which model(s) they want for the POC (small embed-only vs full gen)?

Priya (AE): They run k8s (RHEL8 + containerd). Have A100s. Want a small LLM and embedding model for initial eval.

Rina (Ops): Ops workflow: build minibundle (runtime + chosen model) -> sign artifact -> produce SHA256 manifest + SPDX SBOM -> split into 2GB parts for USB. We include an installer script that supports --airgap. Typical minibundle ~1.9GB, full ~13GB. Need staging host with 40GB free for unpack+registry.

Ellen (Security): Security must be explicit: telemetry disabled by default, signed SBOM, and confirm whether they require our signing key or their HSM. Also need to know CA policy (will they accept our CA import?).

Noah (AM): Pricing approach: one-time packaging fee + courier/handling + optional on-site SE day rate. Ballpark $5k packaging + $1.5k/day for SE. Can discount for strategic customers.

Diego (SE): Verification steps we provide:
sha256sum redwood-bundle.tar.gz > redwood-bundle.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle.sig redwood-bundle.tar.gz
./install.sh --airgap --verify
Installer will load images into local registry and run a smoke test (healthcheck + sample prompt).

Rina (Ops): Upgrade cadence: For the short POC we can ship deltas weekly; for production recommend 3-6 months with emergency hotfixes. Important: deltas assume base image hash matches exactly; otherwise full bundle required.

Ellen (Security): We can provide signed SPDX SBOM and notarization metadata. I'll prep a short security addendum (HSM options, CA guidance, telemetry off, chain-of-custody form) and drop it here.

Priya (AE): Timeline: prospect requested POC within 8 business days. Feasible?

Diego (SE): If we get final inventory and model choice today: build+sign ~36 hours, testing+chunking ~12 hours. Rina can ship within 48 hours after artifact ready. So yes if we move fast.

shipbot: Ticket INF-4301 created: "airgap-usb-bundle-poc" with checklist attached.

Noah (AM): I'll confirm budget and logistics with finance. Priya, please get the courier contact and k8s incluster registry details.

Priya (AE): Will do, thanks everyone. I'll post inventory and courier contact later today.
